must: Prioritize the mobile resident screens and existing flat controls
avoid: Introducing a UI framework for visual polish

decisions: The user rejected the colored background wash. Use flat cool off-white screen backgrounds and a quiet gray outer backdrop; retain the brand palette in headers, cards, and accents.

Welcome screen (Living Leaf direction, chosen from 3 explored options): immersive green gradient field with flat cream disc, breathing + slow orbital rings around the logo, drifting leaves, oversized Poppins headline; transform/opacity-only motion with static reduced-motion state. Backup of pre-redesign files in backups/welcome-pre-redesign/.

Welcome → Login (Get Started) routes through a dramatic curtain lift: the welcome field rises 56px and fades (0.45s var(--ease-out)), then login arrives with its own stagger; reduced motion goes straight through. Same mirrored exit on Login → Home, after which the one-shot home entrance + count-up play. Backups: backups/welcome-transition-backup/, backups/login-home-backup/.
